inv.desc_es:
Local comercial de 60 m² en venta, ubicado en una de las principales arterias comerciales de Málaga, con amplia fachada, techos altos y excelente visibilidad.

Situado en un entorno comercial consolidado, rodeado de reconocidas marcas como Primor, Banco Santander, Domino’s Pizza, Movistar, Mercadona y TEDi, entre otras.

Excelente oportunidad de inversión, con varias compañías actualmente interesadas en su arrendamiento, a una renta mensual que permitiría alcanzar una rentabilidad anual del 6 % sobre el precio de adquisición. [IW].
inv.desc_en:
60 m² commercial space for sale, located on one of the main commercial arteries of Málaga, with a wide facade, high ceilings, and excellent visibility.

Situated in a consolidated commercial environment, surrounded by well-known brands such as Primor, Banco Santander, Domino’s Pizza, Movistar, Mercadona, and TEDi, among others.

Excellent investment opportunity, with several companies currently interested in leasing it at a monthly rent that would allow for an annual yield of 6% on the acquisition price. [IW].
